name: CEN Biotech, Inc.
summary: CEN Biotech, Inc. specializes in the creation, production, and ongoing development of both LED lighting technology and goods made from hemp. The company's future plans include cultivating hemp for use across various sectors, including industrial, medical, and food applications. Furthermore, it provides services in the areas of digital marketing and website development. The firm was founded in 2013 and has its headquarters in Windsor, Canada.
